panels.description: The rugged emergency handset rings beside Orien while Sitara and Roman stand near the evidence. Keep route line and Nayah soft in background. Leave upper-left for the ring sound.
Sitara answers the emergency handset. Roman watches from beside the treatment file. Leave upper-left for Sitara's dialogue.
The handset's cracked screen shows only Orien's partial face through an intermittent connection. His weak breath and frost-stiffened clothing remain visible. Leave the top for his dialogue.
Roman lowers the treatment file as the connection fails and the handset screen goes dark. Leave upper-right for Orien's final dialogue and lower-left for the disconnect sound.

items.speaker: ORIEN
items.text: Croft threatened me. The warnings were scheduled… in case I disappeared.

items.speaker: ORIEN
items.text: Second timestamp. Do not release everything. Release what can be checked.
